parameters.jsCode:
// Airtable sends record fields via automation HTTP request
const record = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;

// Map Airtable Student Onboarding fields to what the pipeline expects
const data = {
  lead_id: record.client_id || record["Client ID"] || "",
  email: record.best_email || record["Best Email"] || "",
  first_name: (record.full_name || record["Full Name"] || "").split(" ")[0] || "",
  last_name: (record.full_name || record["Full Name"] || "").split(" ").slice(1).join(" ") || "",
  full_name: record.full_name || record["Full Name"] || "",
  phone: record.phone || record["Phone"] || "",
  city: record.city || record["city"] || "",
  state: record.customer_state || record["Customer State"] || "",
  street_address: record.street_address || record["Street Address"] || "",
  zip: record.zip_for_scrape || record["Zip for Scrape"] || "",
  sales_rep: record.sales_rep || record["Sales Rep"] || "",
  amount: record.amount || record["Amount $"] || "",
  program_tier: record.program_tier || record["Program Tier Purchased"] || "",
  onboarding_notes: record.onboarding_notes || record["Onboarding Notes"] || "",
  machine_addon: record.machine_addon || record["Machine Add-On"] || "",
  airtable_record_id: record.record_id || record["Record ID"] || "",
  trigger_cw_onboarding: "Yes",
  source: "airtable_resubmit"
};

return [{ json: data }];
